record.reason: AsyncVLA separates edge execution from workstation VLA inference and tests action robustness under artificial 0.2/2/5-second workstation delay. It targets robot navigation and delay tolerance, not LLM inference throughput; system decomposition may merit a transfer check.
record.title: AsyncVLA: An Asynchronous VLA for Fast and Robust Navigation on the Edge
